cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem,rdMolTransforms
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('template.mol',removeHs=False)
p=m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
# Find the planar germanium position at donor-distance circle intersection.
n,o=p[8],p[0];D=np.linalg.norm(o-n);d=(o-n)/D
normal=np.cross(p[3]-n,p[7]-n);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
v=np.cross(normal,d);v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
a=(2.25**2-1.93**2+D**2)/(2*D);h=np.sqrt(2.25**2-a*a)
cs=[n+a*d+h*v,n+a*d-h*v]
lone=-(p[3]+p[7]-2*n);lone/=np.linalg.norm(lone)
metal=max(cs,key=lambda x:np.dot((x-n)/np.linalg.norm(x-n),lone))
print('metal initial donor angles', np.linalg.norm(metal-n),np.linalg.norm(metal-o))
ligp=p-metal
z=np.array([0.,0.,1.]);au=np.zeros(3);cl=np.array([0.,2.32,0.])
# angle Ge-Au-Ge 130 degrees.
ges=[2.4*np.array([-np.sin(np.deg2rad(65)),-np.cos(np.deg2rad(65)),0.]),2.4*np.array([np.sin(np.deg2rad(65)),-np.cos(np.deg2rad(65)),0.])]
coords=[]
for side,g in enumerate(ges):
 w=-g/np.linalg.norm(g)
 u=np.array([-w[1],w[0],0.]) if side==0 else np.array([w[1],-w[0],0.])
 for upper in [True,False]:
  axial=u if upper else -u
  eq=-.5*w+(-1 if upper else 1)*np.sqrt(.75)*z
  local_n=ligp[8]/np.linalg.norm(ligp[8]);local_o=ligp[0]/np.linalg.norm(ligp[0]);co=np.dot(local_n,local_o)
  target_o=co*axial+np.sqrt(1-co**2)*eq
  rot,_=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([axial,target_o]),np.array([local_n,local_o]))
  coords.extend(rot.apply(ligp)+g)
coords.extend([ges[0],ges[1],au,cl]);x0=np.array(coords)
combo=Chem.CombineMols(Chem.CombineMols(m,m),Chem.CombineMols(m,m))
c=Chem.Conformer(72)
for i in range(72):c.SetAtomPosition(i,x0[i])
combo.RemoveAllConformers();combo.AddConformer(c)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(combo)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(combo,props,ignoreInterfragInteractions=True)
for off in range(0,72,18):
 ff.MMFFAddTorsionConstraint(8+off,3+off,2+off,1+off,False,-10,10,10.)
ff.Initialize()
bonds=[];angs=[]
for side,gi in enumerate([72,73]):
 for j in range(2):
  off=side*36+j*18
  bonds.extend([(gi,off,1.93,200.),(gi,off+8,2.25,100.)])
  for ci in [3,7]:angs.append((gi,off+8,off+ci,-.5,55.))
  angs.append((gi,off,off+1,-.5,35.))
 ns=[side*36+8,side*36+26];os=[side*36,side*36+18]
 angs.extend([(ns[0],gi,ns[1],-1.,180.),(os[0],gi,os[1],-.5,55.),(74,gi,os[0],-.5,55.),(74,gi,os[1],-.5,55.)])
 for ni in ns:
  for eqi in [*os,74]:angs.append((ni,gi,eqi,0.,65.))
bonds.extend([(72,74,2.4,200.),(73,74,2.4,200.),(74,75,2.32,200.)])
angs.extend([(72,74,73,np.cos(np.deg2rad(130)),100.),(72,74,75,np.cos(np.deg2rad(115)),100.),(73,74,75,np.cos(np.deg2rad(115)),100.)])
# repulsion between ligands and to nonbonded metal sites.
symbols=[a.GetSymbol() for a in combo.GetAtoms()]+['Ge','Ge','Au','Cl']
rads={'H':1.05,'C':1.65,'N':1.5,'O':1.45,'F':1.4,'Ge':1.9,'Au':1.75,'Cl':1.7}
adj=[set() for _ in symbols]
for b in combo.GetBonds():i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx();adj[i].add(j);adj[j].add(i)
for i,j,_,_ in bonds:adj[i].add(j);adj[j].add(i)
rep=[]
for i in range(76):
 for j in range(i):
  if i<72 and j<72 and i//18==j//18:continue
  if j in adj[i] or adj[i]&adj[j]:continue
  rep.append((i,j,rads[symbols[i]]+rads[symbols[j]]))
ri=np.array([a for a,b,c in rep]);rj=np.array([b for a,b,c in rep]);rr=np.array([c for a,b,c in rep])
def fun(x):
 p=x.reshape(-1,3);lp=x[:216].tolist();E=ff.CalcEnergy(lp);gr=np.zeros_like(p);gr[:72]=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(lp)).reshape(-1,3)
 for i,j,r0,k in bonds:
  v=p[i]-p[j];r=np.linalg.norm(v);q=r-r0;E+=k*q*q;dg=2*k*q*v/r;gr[i]+=dg;gr[j]-=dg
 for i,j,l,c0,k in angs:
  a=p[i]-p[j];b=p[l]-p[j];ra=np.linalg.norm(a);rb=np.linalg.norm(b);u=a/ra;v=b/rb;co=np.dot(u,v)
  if c0==-1.:E+=k*(co+1);dc=k
  else:E+=k*(co-c0)**2;dc=2*k*(co-c0)
  ga=dc*(v-co*u)/ra;gb=dc*(u-co*v)/rb;gr[i]+=ga;gr[l]+=gb;gr[j]-=ga+gb
 dv=p[ri]-p[rj];dist=np.linalg.norm(dv,axis=1);q=np.minimum(dist-rr,0.);E+=10*np.dot(q,q);dg=20*q[:,None]*dv/dist[:,None];np.add.at(gr,ri,dg);np.add.at(gr,rj,-dg)
 return E,gr.flatten()
print('Initial',fun(x0.flatten())[0])
res=minimize(fun,x0.flatten(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':3500,'ftol':1e-10,'gtol':1e-5,'maxls':50})
print(res.success,res.message,res.fun, np.max(np.abs(res.jac)))
p=res.x.reshape(-1,3)
np.save('coords.npy',p)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(symbols)}\nBis(bis(pyridyl-trifluoro-enolato)germanium)gold chloride; coordinates in angstroms\n')
 for s,(x,y,z) in zip(symbols,p):f.write(f'{s:2s} {x: .8f} {y: .8f} {z: .8f}\n')
for i,j,r,k in bonds:print(i,j,symbols[i],symbols[j],round(np.linalg.norm(p[i]-p[j]),3))
# Save connectivity for visualization/verification only.
np.save('bonds.npy',np.array([(b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()) for b in combo.GetBonds()]+[(i,j) for i,j,r,k in bonds]))

base=np.load('coords.npy')
def pose(t):
 p=base.copy()
 for side,gi in enumerate([72,73]):
  w=p[74]-p[gi];w/=np.linalg.norm(w);ids=np.arange(side*36,side*36+36)
  p[ids]=Rotation.from_rotvec(np.deg2rad(t[side]-25)*w).apply(p[ids]-p[gi])+p[gi]
 return p
def f(t):
 p=pose(t);dist=np.linalg.norm(p[ri]-p[rj],axis=1);q=np.minimum(dist-rr,0.)
 return 1000*np.dot(q,q)+.001*np.dot(t,t)
r=differential_evolution(f,[(-50,50),(-50,50)],tol=1e-9,seed=43)
print(r.x,r.fun)
p=pose(r.x)
print('max overlap',np.max(rr-np.linalg.norm(p[ri]-p[rj],axis=1)))
np.save('coords.npy',p)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(symbols)}\n3D structure of the depicted Ge-Au-Cl complex; angstroms, explicit hydrogens\n')
 for s,q in zip(symbols,p):f.write(f'{s:2s} {q[0]: .8f} {q[1]: .8f} {q[2]: .8f}\n')
